name: Phantom
source: Pathfinder Monster Core, Phantom (pg. 262), via Archives of Nethys: https://2e.aonprd.com/MonsterFamilies.aspx?ID=455
license: ORC License: Paizo's Pathfinder Monster Core is ORC licensed material.
rules: For a living creature; no level change. Trades its traits for ethereal, incorporeal and spirit; its Strikes gain magical (and finesse, melee); immunities, resistance to all damage and Phantom Touch.
optional: It loses abilities that come from being a living creature, and traits of its life other than human, humanoid and the ancestries (removed here): remove those by hand, and adjust abilities that conflict with its theme. Many phantoms gain occult innate spells or powers tied to the Ethereal Plane; if you give it more than one new ability, consider raising its level. The resistance uses the resistance table's minimum for its level.

resistances.suffix: (except force, ghost touch, or spirit; double resistance vs. non-magical)

abilities.name: Phantom Touch
abilities.description: Each time {name} makes a Strike, it can choose to deal spirit damage instead of the normal physical damage type.
